title: What did you do?
description: Talk about the past: the ending shows who did it, and whether a man or a woman.

blocks.text: The Polish past tense adds endings to the verb stem. In the singular, the ending also shows gender: a man says byłem (I was), a woman says byłam. He was is był, she was is była. Most verbs follow the same pattern: robić gives robiłem or robiłam (I did), mieszkać gives mieszkałem or mieszkałam (I lived). In the plural, a group that includes at least one man says byliśmy (we were); a group of women says byłyśmy.

blocks.translation: Yesterday I was at the cinema.
Yesterday I was at the cinema.
What did you do at the weekend?
blocks.note: Asking a man. To a woman: Co robiłaś w weekend?

lines.speaker: Kasia
lines.translation: What did you do at the weekend?

lines.speaker: Piotr
lines.text: Byłem w górach z bratem. A ty?
lines.translation: I was in the mountains with my brother. And you?

lines.speaker: Kasia
lines.text: Ja byłam w domu i czytałam książkę.
lines.translation: I was at home and read a book.
